findings.label: Early-partial false-positive freeze (tuning, non-blocking)
findings.where: agent/decision.py MIN_CHARS_BEFORE_FIRST / grounded option descriptions; verification.md
findings.problem: On short early partials the hosted decider can read borderline-grounded (~0.44, conf ~0.55), which the unsure band turns into a freeze on an otherwise clean turn. Confirmed by the coder on a live run; it is a tuning matter, not a build defect — offline score_reflex branch tests and the clean-generation test pass, and seam #1 (before-action) never regresses.
findings.fix: Deferred to the online bench step (plan item 13): raise MIN_CHARS_BEFORE_FIRST so the first checkpoint sees enough code, and/or sharpen the grounded option descriptions; tune on the tune split only and record final thresholds in decision.py's docstring. Non-blocking for this gate.
